name: Futa Sex Therapy
source: In a ruthless corporate jungle thick with tension and forbidden cravings, Futa Sex Therapy throws you headfirst into the private orbit of Vanesa — a magnetic futa psychologist whose clinical calm barely masks a hunger for domination and intimacy. Her “therapy” quickly sheds its neutral mask: whispered confessions turn into breathy, boundary-blurring sessions full of slow, deliberate seduction and escalating erotic charge.
translation: 在气氛紧绷、暗涌着禁忌渴求的冷酷职场丛林里，《扶她性爱疗法》将你一头抛入瓦妮莎的私密领地——这位魅力十足的扶她心理医生表面保持着专业冷静，眼底却掩不住对支配与亲密接触的饥渴。她的“心理治疗”很快便撕下了客观中立的伪装：低声倾诉的隐秘心事化作了气息交缠、界限模糊的私密诊疗，充斥着循序渐进的刻意挑逗与节节攀升的情欲张力。
